module: 2D quadtree for boxes (insertion, removal, query, compression). Unlike k-d trees, elements can be inserted and removed after construction, and an ongoing query is not disturbed by a removal. Each element is (id, xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax). Flow: newQuadtree -> preLoad (to size the canvas) -> build(maxDepth) -> [compress] -> insert/remove/query.
usage:
local tree = require('quadtree')
local q = tree.newQuadtree()
for _, it in ipairs(items) do q:preLoad(it.id, it.xmin, it.ymin, it.xmax, it.ymax) end
q:build(10) -- optional max depth (10 by default)
q:insert(id, xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax)
q:remove(id, centerX, centerY)
for id in q:queryNotNested(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) do ... end
notes: The canvas (root box) is computed by preLoad as the union of the preloaded boxes and no longer changes after build; elements outside the canvas can be inserted/removed/queried (they stay in the nodes close to the root).

Structure: self.tree[i] is the table of the elements of node i (5 values per element: id, xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax — the header comment mentions another xmin/xmax order) with itemCount; self.children[i] is the index of the first of 4 children.

remove(itm_id, itm_x, itm_y) needs the element's CENTER to find it (descent in the tree according to this point); the removal replaces the node's table (supports active queries). An element that overflows the edges of a quadrant stays in the parent node: the removal tests the current node first before descending.
queryNotNested reuses the tree state (no nesting); query allocates a state per query and supports nesting. Both return the ids of the elements whose box intersects the query box.
build(maxDepth) inserts the preloaded elements then frees the preloaded list (itm_preld = nil): preLoad can no longer be called after build (use insert).
compress() copies the node tables to reduce memory; later insertions may be slower (code note).
The fields M.pointBBox and M.lineBBox are references to the global functions pointBB2d and lineBB2d of mathlib (the automatic extraction marks them unknown).

pointBBox.desc: Alias of pointBB2d (mathlib): bounding box of a point expanded by a radius.

lineBBox.desc: Alias of lineBB2d (mathlib): bounding box of a segment expanded by a radius.

newQuadtree.desc: Creates an empty quadtree. Default max depth 10 (the root is depth 1).

numOfItems.desc: number of expected elements for preallocation (optional)

preLoad.desc: Stores an element and enlarges the tree's canvas; to be used before build().

build.desc: Inserts all the preloaded elements into the tree. maxDepth (default 10) bounds the depth.

insert.desc: Inserts an element (after build or during use) into the deepest node that fully contains it.

remove.desc: Removes the element with identifier itm_id by searching along the path leading to its center (itm_x, itm_y). No effect if it is not found.

query.desc: Iterator over the ids of the elements intersecting the query box; supports nested queries and removals during iteration.

queryNotNested.desc: Like query without allocation; do not nest.

compress.desc: Reduces memory by copying the node tables to their exact size. Optional after build.

export.desc: Returns the tree data {tree, children, nodeCount, maxDepth, xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax} (references).

import.desc: Loads data produced by export() (and discards the preloaded list).

analytics.desc: Prints (print) the depth, the number of nodes and of occupied elements.
